title: Reduce E8 recursive cost with four coupled frame changes
body:
Four coupled frame changes lower the recursive cost of Jacob Sussman's [E8 certificate at `9c94857`](https://github.com/jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean/commit/9c94857bbaee886f8649edee0bc2d3c738f9555e). Under the [pinned PR352 fallback convention](https://github.com/DaysSky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/04b4c3c478b5bd8797d2663d89d8db4dfd0ad9f2/research/w3-p10b-e8-complex/code/pricing/moment.py#L55), the conditional complex saving increases from `876248285600677/10^18` to **`876412559609473/10^18`**, approximately **0.01875%**.

Two phase-A retimings and two phase-B frame changes reduce the five-stage recursive child count from **20,830 to 20,825**. The complete rational scalar operator, including all initial helper values, is unchanged. Helpers (783), copy cost (72), rank mass (56,715), deficit (120), and scalar additions (3,876) are also unchanged.

`research/e8-coupled-retiming/PROOF.md` expresses the cost change as a positive weighted sum of discrete second differences of `x^p`. Strict concavity gives a decrease for every `0 < p < 1`; the fallback charge also decreases. The proof does not rely on an approximate numerical root. The standalone package includes both certificates, deterministic reconstruction, independent checks, and a dedicated workflow.

### Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-coupled-retiming/verify.py
```

- **PASS:** pinned inputs, exact reconstruction, frame paths and costs, all 1,046,529 entries of the full rational scalar maps, and all initial helper dependencies.
- **PASS:** exact rational bounds for both savings, rejection of each next `10^-18` grid point, and four damaged-certificate controls, including a forbidden phase-A cancellation. The verifier needs only the Python standard library.
- **Separate upstream checks:** all three checkers pass from pinned Sussman source `9c94857`, including its Lean representation diagnostics. Those scripts are not vendored or run by the package verifier.
- **Repository checks before the verifier cleanup:** 16 of 17 groups passed, including `gen4-bank-verify`, 538 tests, and 20 patch checks. The cleanup passed focused and isolated-package verification; the full suite was not rerun. **The full suite is not green:** `verify-joint` fails on a stale root `Makefile` hash in `research/joint-dual/SOURCE.json`; that manifest also has a stale `README.md` hash. Both files match the unchanged base, `12a4934d`. This PR changes neither file nor the manifest.

### Scope and credit

This is a finite circuit and recursive-cost improvement. It does not change the selected integer-multiplication bound. The new certificate has **not been compiled in Lean**. Frame transfer, helper cleanup, recursion, and multiplication assembly remain inherited dependencies. No global optimum is claimed.

Sussman supplied E8, its checkers, and the proof framework; DaysSky's PR352 supplied the complex connection and fallback convention. Prior retiming includes Sussman's scheduler, [PR328](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/328), and [PR350](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/350). The package preserves upstream notices and licenses. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new contributions are offered under Apache-2.0.
